title: Tole Tole Warning
description: Tole Tole Warning is a client-side accessibility mod that alerts deaf and hard-of-hearing players with a flashing HUD warning and danger alarm when a creeper gets too close.
body:
# Tole Tole Warning

Tole Tole Warning is a client-side Fabric accessibility mod designed to help players notice nearby creepers before it is too late.

When a creeper comes within **10 blocks** of you, the mod triggers an immediate on-screen warning so the danger is much harder to miss.

## What the mod does

When a creeper gets close, Tole Tole Warning activates a full HUD alert that includes:

- flashing warning signs in all four corners of the screen
- a large **"watch out bro..."** warning bubble
- a repeating danger alarm that continues while the creeper stays nearby

As soon as the creeper dies or moves out of range, the warning stops automatically.

## Why use it?

This mod was made with **deaf and hard-of-hearing players** in mind, giving creepers a much clearer visual warning instead of relying only on Minecraft’s normal sound cues.

It can also be useful for any player who wants a stronger panic alert while mining, building, exploring caves, or fighting at night.
